about.title: About · Jotave Tech
about.description: Meet Jotave Tech, a technology company dedicated to mobile solutions and its own apps.
about.lead: An idea that gained its own identity and path
history: Jotave Tech was born from the meeting of a desire to build a business and João Vitor’s passion for the logic of programming. In technology, he found a way to turn reasoning into creation: understanding a problem, organizing its parts and building a solution.

The name carries that origin. JOTAVE combines JOTA, the Portuguese name of the letter J, and VE, the Portuguese name of the letter V: a reference to João Vitor’s initials and to the identity of the person who started the company. From the beginning, the goal was to build something of its own, with its own brand and its own path.
That path began to take shape with Jotave Tech’s first apps: GRO, Balança Diária and Spokn. They open a growing portfolio, created from new ideas and needs that can come to life on a phone.

Jotave Tech keeps moving in that direction: developing its own products and helping other people turn ideas and processes into mobile solutions. A journey that began with the logic of programming and keeps growing with each new project.
about.mission: To turn ideas and processes into easy-to-use apps that make everyday life simpler for the people who use them.
about.vision: To be recognized for the quality, clarity and attention to detail of the apps we develop.

values.title: Precision in every pixel
values.text: We care for the details no one sees, because they are what make an app work well.

values.title: Product first
values.text: Everything we deliver to clients, we have already built and run for ourselves.

values.title: Transparency
values.text: Timelines, costs and technical decisions explained clearly, without jargon.

values.title: Long-term partnership
values.text: Our work doesn’t end at launch: we keep evolving alongside the people who use it.

values.title: Continuous improvement
values.text: We measure, learn and improve with every release.

team_ps: Jotave Tech is built by two people who share the desire to turn good ideas into useful solutions.
João Vitor is the company's founder and leads app development. Ana Paula takes part in creating the products, focusing on experience and design.
With complementary skills, the two move in the same direction: creating solutions that make sense for the people who will use them.
about.cta_p: Tell us your idea or ask about our apps.

faq.title: FAQ · Jotave Tech
faq.description: Answers about Jotave Tech apps, free and paid versions, download, usage and how to contact the team.
faq.lead: Questions about the products, versions, downloads and how to reach the team.

items.q: What are GRO, Balança Diária and Spokn?
items.a: They are Jotave Tech apps. GRO (Occupational Risk Manager) helps occupational safety and health professionals carry out environmental surveys. Balança Diária helps you record your weight every day and set goals to reach your ideal weight. Spokn is a voice journal: you talk about your day and AI transcribes and summarizes it.

items.q: Are the apps available for Android and iPhone?
items.a: All three Jotave Tech apps are available for Android on Google Play. The iPhone versions are in development and will be available on the App Store soon.

items.q: What is the difference between the free and paid versions?
items.a: Each app offers free and paid options with different features. Check the app's page on Google Play to see what each version includes.

items.q: How do I subscribe to or buy the paid version?
items.a: You subscribe or buy directly in the app, using Google Play's payment options.

items.q: Can I cancel the paid version?
items.a: Yes. If you have a subscription, you can cancel it in your Google Play settings. Access to paid features continues until the end of the period you have already paid for. One-time purchases are not subscriptions and do not need to be cancelled.

items.q: Where can I download the apps?
items.a: On Google Play, using the links below.

items.q: Do I need an internet connection to use the apps?
items.a: Whether you need internet depends on the app and the feature. Check each app's description on Google Play to see which features can be used offline.

items.q: How do I get help with a problem in an app?
items.a: Through the contact page, choosing the subject “Help with an app”.

items.q: Can I bring an idea or a process from my company to mobile?
items.a: Yes. Jotave Tech helps people and companies in many different fields turn ideas and processes into mobile apps. Tell us what you need to organize and the team will talk with you about the next steps.

items.q: How do I talk to the team about my idea?
items.a: Through the form on the contact page, choosing the subject “I want to bring an idea to mobile”.

faq.cta_p: Send your question to the team.

gro.name: GRO
gro.card: Occupational Risk Manager: helps occupational safety and health professionals carry out environmental surveys and produces a detailed report of the environments and job roles analyzed.
gro.lead: Occupational Risk Manager: helps occupational safety and health professionals carry out environmental surveys in a wide range of fields.
about: The Occupational Risk Manager (GRO) app is designed to help occupational safety and health (OSH) professionals carry out environmental surveys in a wide range of fields. Built to meet Brazil’s eSocial requirements, GRO was made for those who value quality and accuracy. At the end of the survey, the app provides a detailed report of the environments and job roles analyzed.

spokn.name: Spokn
spokn.card: AI voice journal: talk about your day and the app transcribes it, summarizes it and tags your mood — no typing required.
spokn.lead: AI voice journal. Talk it out: AI transcribes and summarizes your day — private, local-first.
about: Spokn is a voice journal that turns talking into writing. Speak about a moment from your day, and AI transcribes it, writes a summary and tags your mood — no typing required.

Your audio is sent securely just long enough to generate your transcript and summary — then it is discarded. It is never stored on the servers or used to train AI models. The only copy kept is the one on your device, unless you turn on the optional cloud backup, which is encrypted before it ever leaves your phone.
audience: Anyone who wants to keep a journal without typing
People who process their day by thinking out loud
Anyone who wants to follow their mood, goals and intentions over time

features.title: Mood timeline and weekly digest

features.title: Optional cloud backup
